title: Underneath the Tree
headline: Kelly Clarkson sang her own choir on 'Underneath the Tree'
caption:
There's a bari saxophone solo on the bridge of Kelly Clarkson's 'Underneath the Tree', and it's worth listening for once you know how the rest was made.

Greg Kurstin, who co-wrote the song with her, played most of the instruments, using a mellotron and a Chamberlin to evoke Phil Spector's Wall of Sound. He had Clarkson sing all the voices, backing vocals included. Sleigh bells and bell chimes sit on top. Peter Edge, RCA's chief executive, has named Mariah Carey's 'All I Want for Christmas Is You' as its inspiration.

It's No. 3 on Apple Music's US chart today.

🎧 The song: "Underneath the Tree" by Kelly Clarkson (@kellyclarkson)
